title: The Pot a Granite Ridge Resort Credit Application Is Drawn From
content:
Where the entries on a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass account show credit issued for particular reasons, the pot an application is drawn from is taken from those entries rather than from the figure the pass record shows standing.

**First.** Where the pass account shows credit issued to put a billing error right, the pot is the sum of every credit entry the pass account shows issued, less every application already drawn against them, and never below zero. A record whose running figure has had to be corrected is no longer the authority on what stands.

**Second.** Where the pass account shows no credit issued to put a billing error right but does show credit issued to put a service failure right, the pot is the sum of the entries issued to put a service failure right, less every application already drawn, and never below zero.

**Otherwise.** In any other case the pot is not taken from the entries by this rule.

### The two conditions and what each sums

| Credit issued to put a billing error right | Credit issued to put a service failure right | The pot |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | either | every credit entry issued, less every application already drawn |
| no | yes | the entries issued to put a service failure right, less every application already drawn |
| no | no | not taken from the entries by this rule |

In the first case the sum is over every credit entry the pass account shows issued, whatever the reason recorded against each; in the second it is over the entries issued to put a service failure right alone. In both, every application already drawn against credit on that pass account is deducted, and the figure is never below zero however many applications the pass account already shows drawn.

### Worked on a hypothetical account

A pass account showing credit issued of 120.00 because a pass was given up, 60.00 to put a service failure right and 40.00 to put a billing error right, with 75.00 of applications already drawn.

Because an entry standing to put a billing error right is shown, the first condition is met: the pot is 120.00 plus 60.00 plus 40.00, which is 220.00, less the 75.00 already drawn, leaving 145.00. Had no billing error entry stood, the second condition would be met and the pot would be 60.00 less 75.00, which is below zero and is therefore taken as 0.00.
